title: 8055 Alleyway Tenants' Association Tangpu and Social Bureau Activities Chinese Press in the Settlement

page_data.en:
Original on D. 1055.

September 15, 37.

The Secretary,
S. M. C.

Alleyway Tenants' Association.
Tangpu and Social Bureau Activities.
Chinese Press in the Settlement.

I attach a report from D.C. (Crime & Special Branch) in regard to the above. It is suggested in this report that the Council prohibit the existence of any Association within the Settlement without a permit first obtained from the Council.

In this connection the policy of the Tangpu and Social Bureau has in recent years been one of gradual encroachment on Council authority. The case in point is an excellent illustration.

The Social Bureau has from time to time issued orders to places of entertainment and if disobeyed have ordered the Chinese Press to refuse all advertisements.

Newspapers have to register under the Press Law with the Government Bureau and the Bureau can refuse registration or cancel registration if the paper is not to their liking but though published in the Settlement the Council are powerless except to assist in charging Editors under the Press Law at the request of the Chinese

page_data.zh:
原件存于 D. 1055 号卷宗。

1937年9月15日。

致：
上海公共租界工部局秘书。

里弄租户协会。
党部与社会局之活动。
租界内的中文报刊。

兹附上刑事侦缉处兼特别分部（D.C. (Crime & Special Branch)）关于上述事项的报告。该报告建议，工部局应禁止任何未在事先取得工部局许可证的情况下在租界内存在的协会。

就此而言，近年来党部与社会局的政策一直是逐步侵蚀工部局的权力。本案即是一个极好的例证。

社会局不时向娱乐场所发布命令，若遭违抗，则命令中文报刊拒绝刊登其所有广告。

报纸须根据《出版法》向政府主管机关登记，若该机关对报纸不满，可拒绝登记或撤销登记；尽管这些报纸在租界内出版，但除非应中方当局请求依据《出版法》起诉编辑，或在情节显著恶劣时要求依据《出版法》进行更正，否则工部局除协助外无能为力。

**〔此处转录不清〕**

- 2 -

Authorities or demanding corrections under the Press
Law in glaring cases.

The Tangpu issue certificates to labour Unions
in conjunction with the Social Bureau and Labour Head-
quarters and claim the right to settle disputes within
the Settlement.

I bring the above to your notice in case the
full implications of this gradual encroachment are not
clear to the Council.

If possible, in the interests of peace and good
order, there are two very effective things which could
be done.

First, no Association be permitted in the
Settlement without a permit first obtained after
registration with the S.M.C. This to include all
Unions, Associations, whatsoever. Enforcement to be
direct through the Police who would automatically close
all such without permits.

Secondly, no paper be published in the Settlement
without a permit issued after registration with the
Council.

There would be no question of payment for licence
but a permit under certain conditions issued free in both
cases to operate within the Settlement but subject to
withdrawal and authorising direct action by Police.

If management choose to defy the Social Bureau at the
expense of the Council it is possible the permit might
be withdrawn. In normal times Police could put the
〔此处转录不清〕
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

党部会同社会局及劳工总部向工会颁发证书，并声称有权解决租界内的纠纷。

我将上述情况提请注意，以免工部局未能清楚认识到这种逐步侵蚀的全部含义。

为了和平与良好秩序，如有可能，有两项非常有效的措施可以实施。

第一，未经向工部局登记并事先获得许可证，不得允许任何协会在租界内存在。此规定应包括所有工会、协会等一切组织。执行工作由警务处直接负责，警务处将自动关闭所有无此类许可证的组织。

第二，未经向工部局登记并获得许可证，不得在租界内出版任何报纸。

这两种情况均不涉及执照费用问题，而是在特定条件下免费颁发许可证，允许其在租界内运作，但许可证可被撤销，并授权警务处采取直接行动。

如果管理层选择以损害工部局为代价而违抗社会局，许可证可能会被撤销。在平时，警务处可将
〔此处转录不清〕

page_data.en:
- 3 -

Such measures may be straining the Council's
powers but would be none the less effective in checking
agitation in the Press against the Council by interested
parties outside the Settlement and would restore to
some extent the control of the Settlement by the Council
now being seriously eroded by various Government organs.
It would have some good effect on labour agitation.

Many of the worst troublemakers enjoy the hos-
pitality and protection of the Settlement and French
Concession. There is no adequate reason why those taking
part in a deliberate campaign to undermine Council authority
should be allowed to base their activities in the Settlement
and Concession.

If these proposals are feasible at all, I will
submit at any time a further report as to the nature of
permits recommended and attitude of the French Police.

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Acting Commissioner of Police.

IW/.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

此类措施可能会超出工部局的权限范围，但在遏制租界外界利益相关方通过报刊针对工部局进行的煽动活动方面，仍将同样有效，并将部分恢复目前正被各政府机构严重侵蚀的工部局对租界的控制权。这将对劳工煽动活动产生一定的良好影响。

许多最恶劣的滋事分子享有租界和法租界的庇护与保护。没有充分理由允许那些参与蓄意破坏工部局权威运动的人以租界和法租界为基地开展活动。

如果这些提议可行，我将随时提交进一步报告，说明建议颁发的许可证性质以及法国警方的态度。

（签名）K. M. Bourne.
代理警务处长。

IW/.

COPY
September 14, 1937.

Acting Commissioner of Police.

ALLEYWAY TENANTS' ASSOCIATION.

On August 28, 1937, the 1st Special District
(International Settlement) Advisory Committee of
Alleyway Tenants' Association was formed with an office
at 3, Tse Dzeh Li, Yunnan Road, on the instructions of the
local Tangpu and the Bureau of Social Affairs.

No application was made to the Council for permission
to form this organization.

The ostensible object of this organization is to
"instruct and advise alleyway tenants in the formation of
individual associations for mutual protection and unification",
but the real aim is to control completely the residents in
the Settlement and in the French Concession. Thus the
payment of rents, taxes, etc., will be entirely under the
control of this body and all disputes of any nature will be
dealt with through the organization. At present there is
an indirect control over residents here through the Chamber
of Commerce, the Ratepayers' Association and the Street
Unions, but many residents are not reached through these
bodies. The intention is to rectify this and to bring
every Chinese resident under the control of the outside
Chinese Authorities.

The matter was discussed with Commandant Fabre and other
Officers of the French Police. They have closed down the
office in the French Concession. It can be stated
confidentially that the forming of this organization was
the main cause for the issue of the Proclamation dated
page_data.zh:
副本
1937年9月14日。

致：代理警务处长。

里弄租户协会。

1937年8月28日，根据当地党部和社会局的指示，里弄租户协会第一特区（国际租界）咨询委员会成立，办公地点设于云南路资德里3号。

未向工部局申请成立该组织的许可。

该组织表面上的目的是“指导和建议里弄租户组建个人协会，以实现相互保护和统一”，但其真实目的是完全控制租界和法租界的居民。因此，租金、税款等的支付将完全受该机构控制，所有性质的纠纷都将通过该组织处理。目前，通过商会、纳税人协会和街道联合会，对这里的居民存在间接控制，但许多居民并未通过这些团体受到管控。其意图是纠正这一状况，并将每一位中国居民置于外部中国当局的控制之下。

此事已与法捕房总监 Fabre 及其他法国警官讨论。他们已关闭了位于法租界内的办事处。可以机密地指出，该组织的成立是发布 dated

page_data.en:
- 2 -

September 2, 1937. The French Police intend to expel
any person attempting to function on behalf of this
organisation. On September 7, the office opened at 3,
Tse Dzoh Li, Yunnan Road, was closed down and the occupants
forbidden to function in the Settlement.

It would be a good thing if the Council would issue
a Proclamation somewhat similar to that issued by the
French Authorities as, undoubtedly, advantage is being
taken of the present situation to create organizations
which will ensure an almost complete control, by outside
authorities, of Chinese residents in the Settlement.

I attach a translation of the Proclamation issued
by the French Consul-General.

〔签名〕
Deputy Commissioner
(Crime Branch)
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

1937年9月2日公告的主要原因。法国警方打算驱逐任何试图代表该组织行事的人员。9月7日，位于云南路资德里3号的办事处被关闭， occupants 被禁止在租界内活动。

如果工部局能发布一份与法国当局所发公告类似的文件，那将是一件好事，因为毫无疑问，有人正利用当前局势建立组织，以确保外部当局对租界内中国居民实行几乎完全的控制。

兹附上法国总领事所发布公告的译文。

〔签名〕
副警务处长
（刑事分部）

FRENCH CONSULATE GENERAL IN
SHANGHAI.
CONSULAR ORDER.

I, Marcel Baudes, Consul General for France
at Shanghai, Chevalier de Legion d'Honneur, accord-
ing to Article 13 of the Municipal Regulations of
the French Concession dated 15th January 1927, do
order as follows:-

Article 1.....In order to assure the security
of the residents of the French Concession and until
further orders, all individuals will be immediately
expelled who indulge in any activities not authorised
by the French authorities (meetings, formation of
groups, societies, etc.)
